editor.definitionKo: 컴퓨터에서 원시 프로그램을 수정하여 새로운 원시 프로그램을 만들거나, 문장을 편집하는 기능을 갖는 프로그램.
editor.englishDescription: A computer program with which one can create a new source program by correcting a source program, or with which one can edit sentences.

encourage.definitionKo: 생각이나 마음, 의욕 등이 강해지도록 하다.

encourage.definitionKo: 기운이나 정신 등을 더욱 높여 주다.

engage.englishDescription: To join a team or a group to help or to work together.

engage.englishDescription: To give someone a certain amount of money and have him/her work.

epigram.definitionKo: 인생의 진리나 가르침을 담은 짧은 문장.
epigram.englishDescription: A short, clever sentence telling the truth or a lesson of life.

equity.definitionKo: 어느 한쪽으로 기울거나 치우치지 않고 균형을 이루는 성질.
equity.englishDescription: A quality of keeping balance without leaning or tilting to one side.

error.definitionKo: 운동 경기에서 잘 저지르는 평범한 실책.
error.englishDescription: In sports, a common, frequently occurring blunder.

error.englishDescription: A defect in a computer program or system.

error.englishDescription: The difference between calculated or measured value and theoretically correct value.

influence.definitionKo: (비유적으로) 누군가에게 끼치는 영향력.
influence.englishDescription: (figurative) One's influence over someone.

institutionalization.definitionKo: 어떤 것이 제도로 됨. 또는 그렇게 되게 함.
institutionalization.englishDescription: The act of something becoming an institution, or causing it to become an institution.

intemperate.definitionKo: 정도에 지나치지 않도록 알맞게 조절하여 제한하지 못하다.
intemperate.englishDescription: Not being able to control and limit the amount of what one does in order to keep it from being excessive.

interpretation.definitionKo: 문장으로 표현된 내용을 이해하고 설명함. 또는 그 내용.
interpretation.englishDescription: An act of understanding and explaining written contents; or the output of such an act.

interpretation.definitionKo: 사물이나 행위 등의 내용을 판단하고 이해하는 일. 또는 그 내용.
interpretation.englishDescription: An act of examining and understanding the contents of an object or action, etc., or the output of such an act.

interpretation.definitionKo: 모르거나 어려운 것을 알기 쉽게 밝혀 말하는 일.
interpretation.englishDescription: An act of making something difficult easier to understand by explaining it.

interpretation.definitionKo: 어려운 구절이나 글 등을 읽어 뜻을 이해하거나 해석함.
interpretation.englishDescription: An act of reading a tricky phrase or text to understand or interpret its meaning.

interpretation.definitionKo: 어려운 문제나 사건의 내용 등을 알기 쉽게 풀어 설명함. 또는 그런 글이나 책.
interpretation.englishDescription: An act of explaining a tricky or complex problem or case to another person in terms easily understandable, or such a text or book.

interpretation.definitionKo: 서로 다른 나라 말을 사용하는 사람들 사이에서 뜻이 통하도록 말을 옮겨 줌.
interpretation.englishDescription: An act of delivering a message between speakers of different languages, making sure that its meaning is conveyed.

invader.definitionKo: 남의 땅이나 나라, 권리, 재산 등을 범하여 들어가거나 들어온 사람.
invader.englishDescription: A person who attacked and entered another land, country, etc., or who encroached on someone's right, property, etc.

jaywalking.definitionKo: 신호를 무시하거나 횡단보도가 아닌 곳에서 길을 건넘.
jaywalking.englishDescription: The act of crossing a street ignoring the light or at a place that is not a crosswalk.

jumak.definitionKo: 시골 길가에서 밥과 술을 팔고, 돈을 받고 나그네를 묵게 하는 집.
jumak.englishDescription: A traditional Korean tavern in the past, usually located on a street in a rural area, which serves food and liquor, and lodges travelers for money.

k-pop.definitionKo: 현대 한국의 대중가요를 다른 나라의 대중가요에 상대하여 이르는 말. 주로 아이돌 그룹의 노래를 가리킨다.
k-pop.englishDescription: A term used to refer to modern Korean pop music in comparison to pop music from other countries. It mainly refers to songs by idol groups.

kk.definitionKo: 한글 자모 ‘ㄱ’을 겹쳐서 쓴 글자. 이름은 '쌍기역'으로, ‘ㄱ’의 된소리이다.
kk.englishDescription: The consonant in the Korean alphabet consisting of double 'giyeok' which creates a stronger sound than a single 'giyeok'.

lane.definitionKo: 차가 한 줄로 정해진 부분을 통행하도록 차선으로 구분한 찻길의 부분.
lane.englishDescription: A part of a roadway for use by a single line of vehicles, designated by a line painted on the road.

lane.definitionKo: 육상이나 수영 등의 경기에서, 각각의 선수가 나아가는 길.
lane.englishDescription: In a sports game such as an athletic meet or swimming meet, the path where each player runs or swims.

lane.definitionKo: 볼링에서, 공을 굴리게 되어 있는 바닥.
lane.englishDescription: In a bowling alley, the floor where a ball rolls down.

lane.definitionKo: 차가 한 줄로 정해진 부분을 통행하도록 차선으로 구분한 찻길의 부분.
lane.englishDescription: A part of a roadway for use by a single line of vehicles, designated by a line painted on the road.

larceny.definitionKo: 법률에서, 남의 물건을 훔침으로써 성립하는 범죄.
larceny.englishDescription: In law, a crime committed by secretly stealing someone else's property.

league.definitionKo: 야구, 축구 등에서 우승을 가리기 위해 경기를 벌이는 각 스포츠 팀.
league.englishDescription: In a tournament of baseball, soccer, etc., each team playing in a game to win a victory.

league.definitionKo: 야구, 축구 등의 경기 단체의 연맹이 주관하여 모든 팀이 서로 한 번씩 경기를 하여 가장 우수한 팀을 가리는 경기 방식.
league.englishDescription: In a competition hosted by a sports association in such games as baseball, soccer, etc., in which the winner is decided on the basis of the results of all the participating teams playing a game against one another.

league.definitionKo: 서로 마음이 통해 같이 어울리는 사람들.
league.englishDescription: People who understand and mix well with each other.

leprosy.definitionKo: 눈썹이 빠지고 살이 썩어 손발이나 얼굴이 변형되며 눈이 잘 보이지 않게 되는 전염병.
leprosy.englishDescription: A contagious disease, whose symptoms include loss of eyebrows, loss of eyesight, rotten flesh transforming the shapes of hands, feet, or the face.

lesbian.definitionKo: 남자끼리 또는 여자끼리 같은 성 사이의 사랑을 하는 사람.
lesbian.englishDescription: A person who loves someone of his/her own sex.

license.englishDescription: Paper proving that its holder is qualified in a field.

license.definitionKo: 특정 기술에 대해 국가에서 인정하는 자격.
license.englishDescription: A qualification officially recognized by a state in regard to a certain skill.

license.definitionKo: 국가에서 특정한 행위나 영업을 할 수 있도록 허가함.
license.englishDescription: An official authorization by a state for doing a certain act or business.

license.definitionKo: 국가에서 특정한 분야의 기술을 인정하는 내용이나 사실을 적어서 내어 주는 증서.
license.englishDescription: A government-issued document stating that its holder has skill or competence in a certain field.

license.definitionKo: 법률이나 계약에 의하여 다른 사람이 소유하고 있는 물건이나 권리 등을 사용할 수 있는 권리.
license.englishDescription: A right under a law or contract to use an object or a right owned by others.
A certificate issued as a proof of permission.

lighter.englishDescription: A small boat with no sail.

lighter.definitionKo: 가스나 석유 등을 이용해 불을 붙이는 작은 기구.
lighter.englishDescription: A small device used in lighting something with gas, oil, etc.

lighthearted.definitionKo: 신경이 쓰이거나 귀찮지 않고 가볍고 편안하다.
lighthearted.englishDescription: Feeling light and comfortable without being burdened or bothered by something.

linguist.englishDescription: A person who specializes in linguistics.

loophole.englishDescription: A hole or a chasm in something.
(figurative) A way to escape a difficult situation.
A state in which something is not complete or has a weak point.

made-up.definitionKo: 사실과 다르거나 실제로는 없었던 일을 사실처럼 꾸며 만드는 성질을 띤.
made-up.englishDescription: Characterized by having a quality of making something untrue or unreal look true through fabrication.

maldistribution.englishDescription: The state of something unevenly existing in a large quantity in one area.

mandutguk.englishDescription: A soup cooked with mandu, dumpling.

maroon.definitionKo: 검은색과 주황색의 중간색으로, 잘 익은 밤 껍질과 같은 색.
maroon.englishDescription: The color of a well-ripened chestnut's skin.

masterful.englishDescription: One's work or skills, etc., having developed fully.

maximization.definitionKo: 더 이상 커질 수 없을 만큼 커짐. 또는 그렇게 만듦.
maximization.englishDescription: Maximizing something to the limit or the maximized state.
An act of making something as large as possible.

meditative.definitionKo: 고요한 마음으로 사물이나 현상을 관찰하거나 깊이 생각하는.
meditative.englishDescription: Observing or thinking deeply about an object or phenomenon in a quiet state of mind.

meditative.definitionKo: 조용하고 평온한 상태에서 깊이 생각하는 것과 같은 느낌이 있는.
meditative.englishDescription: Thinking deeply in a quiet and calm state.

minicar.definitionKo: 장난감이나 장식용으로 작게 만든 자동차 모형.
minicar.englishDescription: A miniature car made to be used as a toy or ornament.

minutes.definitionKo: 회의의 과정이나 결정 등을 적어 놓은 기록.
minutes.englishDescription: A record of the process or decisions of a meeting.

minutes.definitionKo: 여럿이 모여 의논한 내용, 진행 과정, 결과 등을 적은 기록.
minutes.englishDescription: A written record of the discussion, progress, and outcome of a meeting.

morals.definitionKo: 한 사회의 사람들이 말, 행동, 믿음의 좋고 나쁨을 판단하는 정신적 기준이나 가치 체계.
morals.englishDescription: A mental standard or value system, according to which people of a society judge what is right or wrong with respect to a remark, behavior, or a belief.

morals.definitionKo: 사람의 지식과 도덕, 신체를 아울러 이르는 말.
morals.englishDescription: A compound word for a person's knowledge, morals, and body.

moth.definitionKo: 나비와 비슷하나 몸이 더 통통하고 주로 밤에 날아다니며, 식물에 해를 끼치는 벌레의 알을 낳는 곤충.
moth.englishDescription: An insect similar to a butterfly but with a plumper body, which mainly flies at night and lays eggs of insects that are harmful to plants.

mountain.definitionKo: 평평한 땅보다 훨씬 높이 솟아 있고 대개 나무, 풀, 바위 등이 있는 땅.
mountain.englishDescription: A landmass that rises much higher than flat ground and usually contains trees, grass, rocks, etc.
A cluster of lofty and rocky mountains or mountain ranges.

mountain.definitionKo: 산과 산 사이에 있는 골짜기가 많은 곳.
mountain.englishDescription: A place abundant in valleys between mountains.

moved.definitionKo: 감동을 받아 가슴이 뻐근하거나 벅찬 느낌이 있다.
moved.englishDescription: Being moved emotionally and feeling a twinge or swell in one's heart.

mucous.definitionKo: 생물체의 몸에서 나오는 끈끈한 성질을 가진 액체.
mucous.englishDescription: A sticky liquid that is excreted from the body of a living organism.

mule.definitionKo: 암컷 말과 수컷 나귀 사이에서 난 잡종으로, 나귀와 비슷하게 생긴 동물.
mule.englishDescription: An animal that resembles a donkey, a crossbreed between a female horse and a male donkey.

mule.definitionKo: (비유적으로) 고집이 세어 남의 말을 잘 들으려고 하지 않는 사람.
mule.englishDescription: (figurative) An obstinate person who wouldn't listen to others.

multiple.definitionKo: 어떤 수의 몇 배가 되는 수.
multiple.englishDescription: A number obtained by multiplying another number a certain number of times.
A state of being more than one in numb

multiple.definitionKo: 두 가지 이상이 하나로 합쳐 있는 것.
multiple.englishDescription: A state in which more than two things have been united.

mustard.definitionKo: 겨자의 씨로 만든 노란색의 매운 양념.
mustard.englishDescription: A yellow, spicy seasoning made from mustard seeds.

mustard.definitionKo: 황갈색의 서양 겨자. 또는 그 열매로 만든, 요리에 곁들여 먹는 향신료.
mustard.englishDescription: The yellowish brown fruit of a mustard plant or a spice made of that fruit, eaten with other dishes.

needless.englishDescription: Being of no use or unprofitable.
Being of no use or being not wanted.

nickel.definitionKo: 주로 합금을 만들 때나 도금할 때 쓰는 은백색의 금속 원소.
nickel.englishDescription: A silver-white metallic element, used to make an alloy or to plate something.

obscure.definitionKo: 막거나 감추어 보이거나 통하지 않게 하다.
obscure.englishDescription: To block or hide something so as to prevent it from being visible or connected to something else.

obscure.definitionKo: 뚜렷한 계획이나 희망 등이 없어 마음이 답답하다.
obscure.englishDescription: Feeling frustrated without a clear plan, hope, etc.

obscure.definitionKo: 어떤 말이나 태도가 정확하게 무엇을 뜻하는지 분명하지 않다.
obscure.englishDescription: A remark or attitude being not clear in terms of what it exactly means.

obscure.definitionKo: 행동, 성격, 관계 등이 분명하지 않고 애매모호하다.
obscure.englishDescription: Lacking certainty, being unclear in one's actions, personality, relationship, etc.

obscure.definitionKo: 모습, 소리 등이 흐릿하여 분명하지 않거나 분명하지 못하다.
obscure.englishDescription: A shape, sound, etc., being vague, not clear.
A light being weak or not bright.

obscure.definitionKo: 분명하게 잘 보이거나 들리지 않고 희미하고 흐리다.
obscure.englishDescription: Indistinct and faint, not being seen or heard clearly.
One's words or behavior being not definite.

obsess.definitionKo: 생각이나 마음을 온통 한곳으로 쏠리게 하다.
obsess.englishDescription: To make one's mind or thought occupied by one thing.

official.englishDescription: Related to the state or society.
A government official that has political influence.

official.definitionKo: 직장에서 주로 서류를 처리하는 일에 관한.
official.englishDescription: Related to something at work, especially handling paperwork.
Relating to a country or society.

omit.englishDescription: To not get something that is necessary.

omit.definitionKo: 포함되어야 할 부분을 목록이나 기록에서 빠지다. 또는 그렇게 되게 하다.
omit.englishDescription: For a part that should have been included to be left off a list or record, or make it happen.
To not get something that is necessary.
To miss a remark, letter, etc., out.

omit.definitionKo: 전체에서 일부분을 줄이거나 빼어 짧게 또는 간단하게 만들다.
omit.englishDescription: To reduce or remove a part of a whole to make it short or simple.
To eliminate or fail to include data, etc., in a record.

omit.definitionKo: 밖으로 빼내 다른 데로 나가게 하다.
omit.englishDescription: To take something outside and send it elsewhere.

options.definitionKo: 여럿 중에서 필요한 것을 골라 뽑을 수 있도록 제시한 목록.
options.englishDescription: A list presented so that you can choose what you need from many.

outpost.definitionKo: 전투에 필요한 시설과 장비를 갖추고 군대를 배치해 둔 곳.
outpost.englishDescription: A place with facilities and equipment necessary for a battle, where troops are stationed.

outpost.definitionKo: 적에 맞서 싸우기 위해 군대를 배치한 것. 또는 그 군대가 있는 곳.
outpost.englishDescription: The act of placing troops to fight the enemy, or the location of such troops.
A location where military troops are stationed.

over.englishDescription: The opposite side over a boundary or an obstacle.

overlap.definitionKo: 여러 사물이나 내용이 서로 한데 포개어지다.
overlap.englishDescription: For several objects or contents to be put in the same place.

overlap.definitionKo: 여러 사물이나 내용이 서로 한데 포개어지다.
overlap.englishDescription: For several objects or contents to be put in the same place.

overlap.definitionKo: 여러 가지 일이나 현상이 한꺼번에 일어나다.
overlap.englishDescription: For several events or phenomena to occur all at once.

overlap.definitionKo: 여러 사물이나 내용을 서로 한데 포개다.
overlap.englishDescription: To put several objects or contents in the same place.
The act of things piling on top of one another.
For things to be piled on top of one another.
For things to pile on top of one another.

palpable.definitionKo: 깊이 생각해 보지 않아도 알 수 있을 만큼 상황이나 사정이 확실하거나 분명하다.
palpable.englishDescription: A situation or circumstances being so clear and apparent as to be understood even without careful consideration.

palpable.definitionKo: 깊이 생각해 보지 않아도 알 수 있을 만큼 상황이나 사정이 확실하거나 분명하다.
palpable.englishDescription: A situation or reasons being so clear and distinct as to be figured out even without careful consideration.

palpable.definitionKo: 자세히 따져 보지 않아도 될 만큼 무엇이 확실하다.
palpable.englishDescription: Something being so obvious that one does not need to think about it deeply.

pantomime.definitionKo: 대사나 음향 효과 등의 소리가 없이 배우의 동작만으로 내용을 전달하는 연극.
pantomime.englishDescription: A play in which there is no sound such as actors' lines, sound effects, etc., and content is delivered only through the actor/actress's actions.

paragon.definitionKo: 학식이 높고 인품이 훌륭하여 본받을 만한 사람.
paragon.englishDescription: A person worthy of emulating due to his/her profound knowledge and good personality.

parents.definitionKo: 미성년자에 대해서 법적으로 부모의 권리와 의무를 가지는 사람.
parents.englishDescription: A person who has legal, parental rights and obligations to a minor.
(polite form) Someone's parents, including one's own.
A word used previously to refer to ‘parents.’

pension.definitionKo: 국가나 사회에 특별한 공로가 있거나 일정 기간 동안 국가 기관에서 일한 사람에게 매년 주는 돈.
pension.englishDescription: Money given annually to a person who rendered distinguished service to the state or society, or worked for a state agency for a certain period of time.

permeate.englishDescription: To permeate in or exude from something.
For a place to be full of a certain atmosphere.
For a place to be full of a certain atmosphere.
For moisture, etc., to permeate the inside of something deeply.
For smell, etc., to permeate deeply.
For a feeling or thought, etc., to permeate deeply.

permeate.definitionKo: 빛이나 기체, 액체 등이 틈새로 들어오거나 배어들어 퍼지다.
permeate.englishDescription: For a light, gas, liquid, etc., to enter or permeate through a gap.

permeate.definitionKo: 색깔, 맛, 물기 등이 스미거나 배다.
permeate.englishDescription: For color, flavor, or moisture to permeate or saturate.

permeate.definitionKo: 물이나 비 등의 액체가 스며들어 배게 되다.
permeate.englishDescription: For a liquid such as water, rain, etc., to percolate and soak.

permeate.definitionKo: 물이나 비 등의 액체가 스며들어 배다.
permeate.englishDescription: For a liquid such as water, rain, etc., to percolate and soak.

permeate.definitionKo: 냄새, 빛, 색깔 등이 아늑하게 스며들다.
permeate.englishDescription: For a smell, light, color, etc., to be pervaded cozily.
(figurative) To color or influence something in a certain way.
For a place to be full of a certain atmosphere.

persimmon.definitionKo: 둥글거나 둥글넓적하며 익기 전에는 떫지만 익으면 단맛이 나는 주황색 과일.
persimmon.englishDescription: An orange-colored, round or roundish flat fruit, which is astringent when unripe but sweet when ripe.

placing.englishDescription: Laying something on a stack, etc., and leaving it there.

pledge.definitionKo: 정부, 정당, 입후보자 등이 앞으로 어떤 일을 하겠다고 국민에게 약속함. 또는 그런 약속.
pledge.englishDescription: A government, political party, candidate, etc., promising to achieve certain things for the people, or such a promise.

pledge.definitionKo: 정부, 정당, 입후보자 등이 앞으로 어떤 일을 하겠다고 국민에게 약속하다.
pledge.englishDescription: For a government, political party, candidate, etc., to make promises to do something for the constituents.

pledge.definitionKo: 이미 한 일이나 앞으로 할 일이 틀림이 없음을 단단히 확인하다.
pledge.englishDescription: To make certain that one has done or will do something.

pledge.definitionKo: 다른 사람과 어떤 일을 하기로 미리 정함. 또는 그렇게 정한 내용.
pledge.englishDescription: An act of agreeing with someone to do a certain thing, or details of such an agreement.

pledge.definitionKo: 이미 한 일이나 앞으로 할 일에 틀림이 없음을 단단히 확인함.
pledge.englishDescription: The act of making certain that one has done or will do something.
The act of making a vow to keep a promise.
To make a vow to keep a promise.

pledge.definitionKo: 다른 사람과 어떤 일을 하기로 미리 정하다.
pledge.englishDescription: To agree with someone to do a certain thing.
An act of promising to do something definitely; or such a promise.

tremble.definitionKo: 춥거나 무섭거나 화가 나서 몸이 자꾸 크게 떨리다. 또는 몸을 자꾸 크게 떨다.
tremble.englishDescription: For one's body to keep shaking with cold, fear, or anger; to keep shivering with strenuous movements.

tremble.definitionKo: 어떤 것이 작은 폭으로 빠르게 반복해서 흔들리다.
tremble.englishDescription: For something to be shaken repeatedly and fast in a narrow range.

tremble.definitionKo: 몹시 추워하거나 무서워하다.
tremble.englishDescription: To feel cold or very scared.

tremble.definitionKo: 몸이나 몸의 일부를 반복해서 빠르게 흔들다.
tremble.englishDescription: To shake a part of one's body or whole body, fast and repeatedly.

tremble.definitionKo: 몸이나 몸의 일부가 반복해서 빠르게 흔들리다.
tremble.englishDescription: For a part of one's body or whole body to be shaken fast and repeatedly.

tremble.definitionKo: 차가운 것이 몸에 닿거나 무서울 때 또는 오줌을 눈 뒤에 몸이 떨리는 것.
tremble.englishDescription: A state in which one's body trembles upon contacting something cold, out of fear, or after urinating.

tremble.definitionKo: 몹시 싫거나 괴롭거나 끔찍할 때 몸을 떠는 것.
tremble.englishDescription: A state in which one's body trembles because of aversion, suffering, or fright.

tremble.definitionKo: 몸이 자꾸 작게 파르르 떨리다. 또는 몸을 자꾸 작게 파르르 떨다.
tremble.englishDescription: For one's body to shake slightly and continuously; or to shake one's body slightly and continuously.

tremble.definitionKo: 작고 가볍게 떨다.
tremble.englishDescription: To shiver lightly and slightly.

tremble.definitionKo: 몸이 자꾸 크게 부르르 떨리다. 또는 몸을 자꾸 크게 부르르 떨다.
tremble.englishDescription: For one's body to shake severely and continuously; or  to shake one's body severely and continuously.

tremble.definitionKo: 춥거나 무서워서 자꾸 몸이 떨리다. 또는 자꾸 몸을 떨게 하다.
tremble.englishDescription: For one's body to keep shaking with cold or fear; to keep shaking one's body.

tremble.definitionKo: 춥거나 무서워서 몸이 떨리다. 또는 몸을 떨다.
tremble.englishDescription: For one's body to shake with cold or fear; to shake one's body.

tremble.definitionKo: 춥거나 무섭거나 화가 나서 몸이 자꾸 크게 떨리다. 또는 몸을 자꾸 크게 떨다.
tremble.englishDescription: For one's body to shake severely and continuously with cold, fear, or anger; to shake one's body severely and continuously.

tremble.definitionKo: 춥거나 무서워서 몸이 자꾸 몹시 떨리다. 또는 몸을 자꾸 몹시 떨다.
tremble.englishDescription: For one's body to keep shaking severely with cold or fear; to keep shaking one's body severely.

tremble.definitionKo: 춥거나 무서워서 몸이 몹시 떨리다. 또는 몸을 몹시 떨다.
tremble.englishDescription: For one's body to shake severely with cold or fear; to shake one's body severely.

tremble.definitionKo: 팔다리나 몸이 자꾸 크게 떨리다. 또는 팔다리나 몸을 자꾸 크게 떨다.
tremble.englishDescription: For one's arms or body to tremble repeaptedly, greatly; or to shake one's arms or body repeatedly, greatly.

tremble.definitionKo: 팔다리나 몸이 자꾸 크게 떨리다. 또는 팔다리나 몸을 자꾸 크게 떨다.
tremble.englishDescription: For one's arms or body to tremble wildly in a repeated manner; or to shake one's arms or body wildly in a repeated manner.

tremble.definitionKo: 팔다리나 몸이 자꾸 크게 떨리다. 또는 팔다리나 몸을 자꾸 크게 떨다.
tremble.englishDescription: For one's arms or body to tremble wildly in a repeated manner; or to shake one's arms or body wildly in a repeated manner.

unesco.definitionKo: 교육이나 과학, 문화의 보급과 국제 교류 증진을 통한 국제간의 이해와 세계 평화를 추구하는 국제 연합 전문 기관. 본부는 프랑스 파리에 있다.
unesco.englishDescription: A specialized organization of the United Nations that pursues international understanding and world peace through the dissemination of education, science, and culture and the promotion of international exchange; the headquarters is in Paris, France.

unfriendliness.definitionKo: 사람을 대하는 태도가 상냥하거나 부드럽지 않음.
unfriendliness.englishDescription: An attitude of not being gentle and nice to a person.

unhealthy.definitionKo: 생각이나 의식, 분위기 등이 어둡고 올바르지 않다.
unhealthy.englishDescription: Thoughts, consciousness, atmosphere, etc. are dark and incorrect.

unreasonably.englishDescription: In a very absurd and unreasonable manner.
In the manner of being unreasonable, disregarding the situation.

unreasonably.definitionKo: 황당하고 신뢰성이 없어 전혀 근거가 없이.
unreasonably.englishDescription: Without a foundation, as something is ridiculous and lacks credibility.
In the manner that one's speaking or behavior is not suitable for a particular situation.

unrighteousness.definitionKo: 사람의 도리나 정의 등에 어긋나 옳지 않음.
unrighteousness.englishDescription: A state of being wrong, going against a man's duty, injustice, etc.

uplands.englishDescription: A peak or high area of land.

uttering.definitionKo: 소리 내어 말을 하는 것. 또는 그 말.
uttering.englishDescription: The act of letting out spoken sounds, or words uttered in such a way.

vacation.definitionKo: 학교에서 한 학기가 끝나고 정해진 기간 동안 수업을 쉬는 것. 또는 그 기간.
vacation.englishDescription: A fixed period of suspension of classes after one semester of school, or such a period.

vacation.definitionKo: 더위를 피하거나 편안히 쉬려고 가는 휴가.
vacation.englishDescription: A vacation that one goes on to avoid the heat or relax.

vacation.definitionKo: 직장이나 군대 등의 단체에 속한 사람이 일정한 기간 동안 일터를 벗어나서 쉬는 일. 또는 그런 기간.
vacation.englishDescription: A state in which a person belonging to an organization such as a company or an army leaves his/her workplace and takes a rest for a limited period of time; or such a period.

valueless.englishDescription: Having little value or low quality.

vanilla.definitionKo: 열대 식물의 열매에서 짜낸 것으로 과자나 아이스크림에 넣는 향료.
vanilla.englishDescription: A substance obtained by squeezing the fruit of a tropical plant, which is used to flavor confections or ice cream.

vapor.definitionKo: 물이 증발하여 기체 상태로 된 것.
vapor.englishDescription: The gaseous state of water after vaporization.
Water in the form of a gas.

vertigo.englishDescription: A symptom characterized by a lightheaded feeling and blurred vision.
A symptom in which one feels hazy due to dizziness.

walker.englishDescription: A person who walks in a street.

whirr.definitionKo: 기계나 바퀴 등이 빠르고 세게 돌아가는 소리. 또는 그 모양.
whirr.englishDescription: A word imitating the sound or describing the motion of a machine or wheel operating or spinning around powerfully, quickly.

whirr.definitionKo: 기계나 바퀴 등이 빠르게 돌아가는 소리. 또는 그 모양.
whirr.englishDescription: A word imitating the sound or describing the motion of a machine or wheel operating or spinning around quickly.

worthy.englishDescription: An object, etc. being very valuable.
Having a big value or rewarding quality.

wrestling.definitionKo: 두 사람이 매트 위에서 맨손으로 맞붙어 상대편의 두 어깨를 바닥에 닿게 함으로써 승부를 겨루는 운동 경기.
wrestling.englishDescription: A sport in which two persons struggle hand-to-hand on a mat, each trying to press his/her opponent's shoulders to the ground.

wretchedness.definitionKo: 견딜 수 없을 정도로 슬프고 끔찍함.
wretchedness.englishDescription: An unbearably sad and dreadful feeling.
The state of being very miserable and feeling terrible.

x-ray.definitionKo: 보통의 빛이 뚫고 지나가지 못하는 물체를 뚫고 지나가는, 눈에 보이지 않는 광선.
x-ray.englishDescription: An invisible ray that passes through an object impenetrable by ordinary light.

x-ray.definitionKo: 질병의 진단이나 재료의 검사 등을 위하여 눈으로 볼 수 없는 물체의 내부를 엑스선을 이용해 찍는 사진.
x-ray.englishDescription: A picture, taken with x-rays, of the invisible interior of an object for diagnosing a disease or testing materials.

x-ray.definitionKo: 보통의 빛과 달리 물체를 뚫고 지나가서 질병의 진단 및 치료, 금속 재료의 내부 검사 등에 쓰이는 광선.
x-ray.englishDescription: A ray that penetrates through an object unlike other lights, used in the diagnosis and treatment of diseases, testing of metals, etc.

yeo-uiju.definitionKo: 무엇이든 원하는 대로 이루어 준다고 하는, 용이 물고 있는 구슬.
yeo-uiju.englishDescription: cintamani; dragon stone: A jewel held by a dragon, which is said to realize whatever one wishes for.

yeonssaum.definitionKo: 연을 날려 서로 연실을 마주 걸어서 상대방의 연실을 끊는 놀이.
yeonssaum.englishDescription: kite fighting: A game in which kite flyers compete by crossing their kite strings to cut each other.

youth.englishDescription: Young age. Or something like that.
The state of being young both physically and mentally.
The time when one was young.

youth.definitionKo: 육체적으로나 정신적으로 다 자란 젊은 사람.
youth.englishDescription: A young person who is mature both physically and mentally.
The time during which one is young.

youth.definitionKo: 사회 구성원 가운데 청년기에 있는 사람들.
youth.englishDescription: People who are in their adolescence.
One's young days, the early part of one's life.
